trap-superlative.notes: Scoped by the conditional, so not an unqualified maximum-strength claim. STRUCTURAL FINDINGS recorded here instead. (1) MARKDOWN RENDER HAZARD: unescaped '*' inside emphasis spans. Line 1 is '**Conjecture (graded Baer-* on ...).**' and line 10 is '*Each ... is a Baer-*-ring ... are **Baer-*-morphisms**: ... with*'. The bare '*' in 'Baer-*' will pair with the surrounding emphasis markers, so the intended italic statement and the bold term both mis-render (on line 10 the first italic span closes at 'Baer-' instead of at the end of the paragraph). Same hazard on lines 20 and 25 ('Baer-* structure', 'Baer-* is trivial'). Proposed: escape as 'Baer-\\*'. This is a render-QA item, not a trap, and I did not fix it inline because it is notation. (2) Minor math: the third bulleted axiom reads 'sum_i p_n^{(i)} . id_{G^{(n)}} = id_{G^{(n)}}', where the '. id' is redundant - the completeness relation is sum_i p_n^{(i)} = id_{G^{(n)}}.
